reserveReview.rationale: Updated on 2026-11-22 from Hamilton Lane's SCOPE Global Monthly Report for September 2026 (as of 2026-09-30; PDF metadata creation date 2026-10-30, SHA-256 cedc564f18509b4afe246ed264cf8770318f76f55678305f15f7177b0d2aaf62). Page 2 Current Portfolio Construction reports Main Fund Security Type weights totaling 100%: 99% First Lien Senior Secured and 1% Junior Debt (100% floating rate; $2.69B fund total assets at manager-approved fair market value; 89% North America and 11% Europe; 34% Industrials Business Services, 18% IT, 15% Health Care, 11% Consumer Discretionary, 9% Industrials Other, 5% Financials, 3% Communication Services, 2% Consumer Staples, 2% Materials, 1% Real Estate; >500 issuers across 139 unique investments; 43% weighted-average company LTV, 5.1x average borrower debt-to-EBITDA, 2.3x interest coverage, and moderate fund-level leverage). Confidence stays probable because this report measures the Luxembourg Main Fund (SCOPE S.A. SICAV-RAIF) rather than the separate Delaware tokenized feeder (Hamilton Lane SCOPE Securitize Tokenized Feeder, LP), is unaudited manager reporting without liability reconciliation, and does not disclose feeder-level cash, fees, leverage, or a token-to-fund share denominator. The strategy page Share Class Performance table was separately observed updated to 31/10/2026, but neither an October 2026 Main Fund PDF nor any public tokenized-feeder holdings report was published as of 2026-11-22; the tokenized-feeder report remains an open issuer wait.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The December 2025 Main Fund PPM names Brown Brothers Harriman (Luxembourg) S.C.A. as AIFMD depositary and distinguishes registered Main Fund shareholder rights from rights exercised through an intermediary. Hamilton Lane's feeder disclosure expressly states that its offering is separate and distinct from SCOPE. Neither source establishes enforceable insolvency-protection or pass-through rights for holders of the tokenized Delaware feeder. The 2026-08-29 structured label, inferred from the Main Fund depositary appointment and separation from Securitize's tokenization stack, was withdrawn on 2026-10-01 under D09. The appointment and technical tokenization remain recorded, but feeder custody, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and reuse terms remain unknown. This narrow legal-boundary review does not newly verify the SEC filing or re-date other provider claims.
